notes: The ASV compresses asher tassig yad into the ability; that is taken as a noncompositional idiom rather than leaving two morphemes unrepresented (rules 6, 30).
The of before him that vowed is placed with the substantival article's unit as the construct relation; putting it on the participle was the competing reading (rules 19, 41).
al pi is one compound rendering according to, headed on the content word under rule 24; the object suffix of he'emido becomes the subject of the ASV's passive recasting under rules 18 and 40.
